title: E0080: Weak cryptographic function
plain_english: Using `crypt()` for password hashing, or using it with weak parameters, is unsafe. Use a modern password hashing function such as `password_hash()`.
why_matters: `crypt()` with weak parameters (such as DES-based crypt) is vulnerable to: - Fast brute-force attacks due to limited key space - Rainbow table attacks when no salt or a weak salt is used - Outdated behavior compared to bcrypt or Argon2 used by `password_hash()`
bad_example:
$hash = crypt($password, '$1$saltsalt$'); // MD5-based crypt, weak
$hash = crypt($password);                   // uses system default, may be weak
